<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Atkinson+Hyperlegible:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;1,400&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;600&display=swap">
<style>
.pmx {
  --bg: #fbfaf7;
  --card: #ffffff;
  --ink: #18202a;
  --muted: #5d6773;
  --line: #e4e1da;
  --soft: #f3f1ec;
  --accent: #1f6f5c;
  --accent-soft: #e6f2ee;
  --sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
  --mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
}
.pmx * { box-sizing: border-box; }
.pmx {
  margin: 0; background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.55;
}
.pmx a { color: var(--accent); text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.pmx a:focus-visible, .pmx summary:focus-visible, .pmx .check input:focus-visible + .box { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }
.pmx code { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.86em; background: var(--soft); padding: 0.1em 0.35em; border-radius: 4px; }
.pmx .wrap { max-width: 860px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 16px; }
.pmx header.top { padding: 40px 0 8px; }
.pmx .brand { font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; font-size: 15px; color: var(--muted); margin: 0 0 18px; }
.pmx .brand b { color: var(--ink); }
.pmx h1 { font-size: clamp(30px, 5.2vw, 46px); line-height: 1.12; margin: 0 0 14px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-wrap: balance; }
.pmx .lede { font-size: clamp(17px, 2.3vw, 20px); color: var(--muted); margin: 0 0 22px; max-width: 40em; }
.pmx .progress { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; margin: 26px 0 18px; }
.pmx .bar { flex: 1; height: 8px; background: var(--soft); border-radius: 99px; overflow: hidden; }
.pmx .bar span { display: block; height: 100%; width: 0; background: var(--accent); border-radius: 99px; transition: width .25s ease; }
.pmx .progress output { font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; white-space: nowrap; min-width: 7.5em; text-align: right; }
.pmx ol.steps { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 16px; }
.pmx .step {
  background: var(--card); border: 1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 24px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 72px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 20px; align-items: start;
  transition: border-color .2s, background .2s;
}
.pmx .step.done { border-color: var(--accent); background: #fcfefd; }
.pmx .check { position: relative; display: block; cursor: pointer; padding-top: 4px; }
.pmx .check input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 34px; height: 34px; margin: 0; cursor: pointer; }
.pmx .box {
  width: 34px; height: 34px; border: 2px solid #b9b4aa; border-radius: 9px; display: grid; place-items: center;
  background: #fff; transition: background .15s, border-color .15s;
}
.pmx .box svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; opacity: 0; transition: opacity .15s; }
.pmx .check input:checked + .box { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); }
.pmx .check input:checked + .box svg { opacity: 1; }
.pmx .icon { width: 72px; height: 72px; color: var(--ink); display: grid; place-items: center; }
.pmx .icon svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.pmx .step-num { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent); margin: 0 0 2px; }
.pmx .step h2 { font-size: 23px; line-height: 1.25; margin: 0 0 8px; }
.pmx .step.done h2 { text-decoration: line-through; text-decoration-color: rgba(31,111,92,.5); text-decoration-thickness: 2px; }
.pmx .step p { margin: 0 0 12px; }
.pmx .step p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
.pmx .files { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 4px 0 0; display: grid; gap: 8px; }
.pmx .files li { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 4px 12px; padding: 10px 14px; background: var(--soft); border-radius: 10px; }
.pmx .files a { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; word-break: break-all; }
.pmx .files small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 15px; }
.pmx .either { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 18px; margin: 6px 0 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.pmx .either figure { margin: 0; text-align: center; width: 92px; }
.pmx .either figure svg { width: 44px; height: 44px; color: var(--ink); display: block; margin: 0 auto 4px; }
.pmx .either figcaption { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.3; }
.pmx .either .or { align-self: center; font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted); font-style: italic; padding-bottom: 18px; }
.pmx .btn {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; text-decoration: none;
  background: var(--accent); color: #fff; font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px;
  padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 10px; margin-top: 4px;
}
.pmx .btn:hover { background: #185a4a; }
.pmx .btn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
.pmx .hint { color: var(--muted); font-size: 15px; }
.pmx .allset {
  display: none; margin: 18px 0 0; padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--accent-soft); color: #134d40; font-weight: 700;
}
.pmx .allset.show { display: block; }
.pmx section.block { margin: 56px 0 0; }
.pmx .block h2.sec { font-size: 26px; margin: 0 0 6px; }
.pmx .block p.sub { color: var(--muted); margin: 0 0 18px; }
.pmx .scenario { background: var(--card); border: 1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px; padding: 22px 24px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 24px; align-items: center; }
.pmx .scenario dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 8px 18px; margin: 0; font-size: 16px; }
.pmx .scenario dt { color: var(--muted); }
.pmx .scenario dd { margin: 0; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.pmx .chart { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
.pmx .chart text { font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 10px; fill: var(--muted); }
.pmx .legend { display: flex; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 4px; }
.pmx .legend span::before { content: ""; display: inline-block; width: 16px; height: 3px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--c); vertical-align: middle; margin-right: 6px; }
.pmx .keys { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.pmx .keys li { background: var(--card); border: 1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; }
.pmx .keys code { background: none; padding: 0; font-weight: 600; color: var(--accent); font-size: 15px; }
.pmx .keys span { display: block; color: var(--muted); font-size: 15px; margin-top: 2px; }
.pmx .faq { border-top: 1.5px solid var(--line); }
.pmx .faq details { border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--line); }
.pmx .faq summary {
  list-style: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 18px 40px 18px 0; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; position: relative;
}
.pmx .faq summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
.pmx .faq summary::after {
  content: ""; position: absolute; right: 8px; top: 50%; width: 10px; height: 10px; margin-top: -7px;
  border-right: 2px solid var(--ink); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink); transform: rotate(45deg); transition: transform .2s;
}
.pmx .faq details[open] summary::after { transform: rotate(-135deg); margin-top: -2px; }
.pmx .faq .a { padding: 0 0 18px; max-width: 42em; }
.pmx .faq .a p { margin: 0 0 10px; }
.pmx .faq .a p:last-child { margin: 0; }
.pmx pre.mini { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 14px; background: var(--soft); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 14px; margin: 8px 0 10px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6; }
.pmx pre.mini .c { color: #7b8490; }
.pmx footer { margin: 56px 0 0; padding: 22px 0 40px; border-top: 1.5px solid var(--line); color: var(--muted); font-size: 15px; }
.pmx footer a { color: var(--ink); }
@media (max-width: 640px) {
.pmx header.top { padding-top: 28px; }
.pmx .step { grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 14px 16px; padding: 18px; }
.pmx .icon { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; width: 52px; height: 52px; justify-self: start; }
.pmx .step .body { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.pmx .scenario { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding: 18px; }
.pmx .scenario dl { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 0; }
.pmx .scenario dd { margin-bottom: 8px; }
}

.pmx h1, .pmx h2 { border: 0; padding: 0; font-family: var(--sans); }
.pmx { background: transparent; }
#title-block-header { display: none; }

.pmx .btn.alt { background: transparent; color: var(--accent); border: 1.5px solid var(--accent); margin-top: 12px; }
.pmx .btn.alt:hover { background: var(--accent-soft); }
</style>

<div class="wrap">

<header class="top">
  <p class="brand"><b>PMxbench</b> &middot; a pharmacometrics benchmark from the AIML-SIG</p>
  <h1>Analyze one PK study. Send back one file.</h1>
  <p class="lede">The study is simulated, so there is a right answer. Three steps, any software you like. Tick each box as you go.</p>

  <div class="progress" aria-live="polite">
    <div class="bar" aria-hidden="true"><span id="fill"></span></div>
    <output id="count">0 of 3 done</output>
  </div>
</header>

<ol class="steps">
  <li class="step" id="s1">
    <label class="check" aria-label="Mark step 1 as done"><input type="checkbox"><span class="box"><svg aria-hidden="true"><use href="#tick"/></svg></span></label>
    <div class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg><use href="#g-doc"/></svg></div>
    <div class="body">
      <p class="step-num">Step 1</p>
      <h2>Download three files</h2>
      <p>That is everything you need. No sign-up for this part.</p>
      <ul class="files">
        <li><a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AIML-SIG/Agentic-workflows/main/tools/pmxbench/scenario_00/data.csv">data.csv</a> <small>the dataset, one row per record</small></li>
        <li><a href="https://github.com/AIML-SIG/Agentic-workflows/blob/main/tools/pmxbench/scenario_00/sap.md">sap.md</a> <small>the protocol and analysis plan. Read this first.</small></li>
        <li><a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AIML-SIG/Agentic-workflows/main/tools/pmxbench/scenario_00/submission.template.yaml">submission.template.yaml</a> <small>the answer form you fill in</small></li>
      </ul>
      <a class="btn alt" href="downloads/scenario_00.zip" download>Download all three (.zip)
        <svg viewBox="0 0 18 18" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 3v10M5 9l4 4 4-4M3 15h12" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></a>
    </div>
  </li>

  <li class="step" id="s2">
    <label class="check" aria-label="Mark step 2 as done"><input type="checkbox"><span class="box"><svg aria-hidden="true"><use href="#tick"/></svg></span></label>
    <div class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg><use href="#g-code"/></svg></div>
    <div class="body">
      <p class="step-num">Step 2</p>
      <h2>Run the analysis your way</h2>
      <p>Do the population PK analysis that <code>sap.md</code> asks for. NONMEM, nlmixr2, Monolix, Pumas, anything works.</p>
      <div class="either" aria-label="Two ways to do it">
        <figure><svg aria-hidden="true"><use href="#g-code"/></svg><figcaption>Your own script</figcaption></figure>
        <span class="or">or</span>
        <figure><svg aria-hidden="true"><use href="#g-llm"/></svg><figcaption>An AI agent</figcaption></figure>
      </div>
      <p class="hint">Both are welcome. The leaderboard records which one you used.</p>
    </div>
  </li>

  <li class="step" id="s3">
    <label class="check" aria-label="Mark step 3 as done"><input type="checkbox"><span class="box"><svg aria-hidden="true"><use href="#tick"/></svg></span></label>
    <div class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg><use href="#g-doc"/></svg></div>
    <div class="body">
      <p class="step-num">Step 3</p>
      <h2>Fill in the form and submit it</h2>
      <p>Put your results into the template. Save it as <code>submission.yaml</code>. Then paste the whole file into the submission form on GitHub.</p>
      <a class="btn" href="https://github.com/AIML-SIG/Agentic-workflows/issues/new?template=pmxbench-submission.yml">Open the submission form
        <svg viewBox="0 0 18 18" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 9h10M10 5l4 4-4 4" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></a>
      <p class="hint" style="margin-top:10px">Needs a free GitHub account. See the questions below.</p>
    </div>
  </li>
</ol>

<p class="allset" id="allset">All three done. We score your file against the answer key and post the result on the leaderboard.</p>

<section class="block" aria-labelledby="h-study">
  <h2 class="sec" id="h-study">The study</h2>
  <p class="sub">Scenario 00. Open to everyone.</p>
  <div class="scenario">
    <div>
      <p style="margin:0 0 12px;font-weight:700;font-size:19px;line-height:1.3">First-in-human study of an IgG1 monoclonal antibody</p>
      <dl>
        <dt>Subjects</dt><dd>120 healthy adults, 50 to 110 kg</dd>
        <dt>Dosing</dt><dd>Single 1-h IV infusion of 100, 300 or 600 mg</dd>
        <dt>Sampling</dt><dd>Predose to day 150, 13 draws each</dd>
        <dt>Assay</dt><dd>LLOQ 0.1 mg/L</dd>
        <dt>Covariates</dt><dd>WT, ALB, CRCL</dd>
      </dl>
    </div>
    <figure style="margin:0">
      <svg class="chart" viewBox="0 0 320 172" role="img" aria-label="Median concentration over 150 days for each dose on a log scale, falling from about 30, 95 and 200 mg/L to under 1 mg/L">
        <g stroke="#e4e1da" stroke-width="1">
          <line x1="44" x2="312" y1="150" y2="150"/><line x1="44" x2="312" y1="110.9" y2="110.9"/>
          <line x1="44" x2="312" y1="71.8" y2="71.8"/><line x1="44" x2="312" y1="32.7" y2="32.7"/>
        </g>
        <g text-anchor="end"><text x="39" y="153">0.1</text><text x="39" y="114">1</text><text x="39" y="75">10</text><text x="39" y="36">100</text></g>
        <g text-anchor="middle"><text x="44" y="164">0</text><text x="97.6" y="164">30</text><text x="151.2" y="164">60</text><text x="204.8" y="164">90</text><text x="258.4" y="164">120</text><text x="303" y="164">150 d</text></g>
        <text x="44" y="10">Median concentration, mg/L (log scale)</text>
        <g fill="none" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round">
          <polyline stroke="#9fd1c3" points="44.1,52.5 45.8,55.8 49.4,63.2 56.5,69.1 69.0,74.0 94.0,81.5 119.0,88.3 144.1,96.3 169.1,103.1 204.8,113.8 258.4,127.1 312.0,131.0"/>
          <polyline stroke="#4b9e88" points="44.1,33.5 45.8,37.8 49.4,43.0 56.5,49.8 69.0,55.8 94.0,62.1 119.0,71.5 144.1,76.2 169.1,81.5 204.8,92.8 258.4,106.8 312.0,119.2"/>
          <polyline stroke="#174f42" points="44.1,21.1 45.8,26.4 49.4,32.3 56.5,38.8 69.0,43.5 94.0,51.0 119.0,59.7 144.1,67.0 169.1,75.6 204.8,84.2 258.4,100.0 312.0,113.9"/>
        </g>
      </svg>
      <figcaption class="legend"><span style="--c:#9fd1c3">100 mg</span><span style="--c:#4b9e88">300 mg</span><span style="--c:#174f42">600 mg</span></figcaption>
    </figure>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="block" aria-labelledby="h-keys">
  <h2 class="sec" id="h-keys">The five answers you report</h2>
  <p class="sub">Each one is defined in section 9 of <code>sap.md</code>. Leave out anything your analysis did not cover.</p>
  <ul class="keys">
    <li><code>structural_ncmt</code><span>How many compartments your final model has</span></li>
    <li><code>disposition_params</code><span>Typical CL, volumes and distribution parameters at 70 kg</span></li>
    <li><code>error_model</code><span>The residual error terms</span></li>
    <li><code>cov_effects</code><span>Which covariates act on which parameter, and how strongly</span></li>
    <li><code>outlier_records</code><span>The <code>ROWID</code>s of records you flagged as data errors</span></li>
  </ul>
</section>

<section class="block" aria-labelledby="h-faq">
  <h2 class="sec" id="h-faq">Questions people ask</h2>
  <p class="sub">Short answers. Tap a question to open it.</p>
  <div class="faq">
    <details>
      <summary>What is YAML?</summary>
      <div class="a">
        <p>A plain text file with one <code>name: value</code> per line. You can open and edit it in Notepad, TextEdit, RStudio or any text editor. Lines that start with <code>#</code> are notes and are ignored.</p>
        <pre class="mini"><span class="c"># this line is a note</span>
structural_ncmt: &lt;your value&gt;
outlier_records: ["&lt;row id&gt;"]</pre>
        <p>Indentation matters, so keep the spaces at the start of each line as they are in the template.</p>
      </div>
    </details>
    <details>
      <summary>Do I need NONMEM?</summary>
      <div class="a"><p>No. Use whatever you are comfortable with: NONMEM, nlmixr2, Monolix, Pumas, or your own code. Only the answers in your file are scored, not the software.</p></div>
    </details>
    <details>
      <summary>Can I use ChatGPT or Claude?</summary>
      <div class="a"><p>Yes. Running the analysis with an AI agent is allowed and is part of what the benchmark measures. The template has a short section where you say what did the work (by hand, or which agent and model), so results can be compared fairly.</p></div>
    </details>
    <details>
      <summary>How is it scored?</summary>
      <div class="a"><p>The data were simulated from a known model, so there is an answer key. Maintainers compare your file with it. You get a score from 0 to 1 in each area (structural model, estimation, covariate analysis, data quality) plus an overall score. 1 means a full match.</p></div>
    </details>
    <details>
      <summary>Do I need a GitHub account?</summary>
      <div class="a"><p>Yes, to submit. The submission form is a GitHub issue, and GitHub only lets signed-in users open one. The account is free and takes a couple of minutes at <a href="https://github.com/signup">github.com/signup</a>. You do not need it to download the files or do the analysis.</p></div>
    </details>
    <details>
      <summary>What if I can't answer one of the five?</summary>
      <div class="a"><p>Leave it out. The template says so too: report only what your analysis supports, and do not guess.</p></div>
    </details>
  </div>
</section>

<footer class="pmx-foot">
  Past results are on the <a href="leaderboard.html">leaderboard</a>. All files live in <a href="https://github.com/AIML-SIG/Agentic-workflows/tree/main/tools/pmxbench">tools/pmxbench</a>.
</footer>

</div>

<script>
(function () {
  var steps = document.querySelectorAll('.step');
  var fill = document.getElementById('fill');
  var count = document.getElementById('count');
  var allset = document.getElementById('allset');
  function update() {
    var n = 0;
    steps.forEach(function (s) {
      var on = s.querySelector('input').checked;
      s.classList.toggle('done', on);
      if (on) n++;
    });
    fill.style.width = (n / steps.length * 100) + '%';
    count.textContent = n + ' of ' + steps.length + ' done';
    allset.classList.toggle('show', n === steps.length);
  }
  steps.forEach(function (s) { s.querySelector('input').addEventListener('change', update); });
  update();
})();
</script>
</div>
